title: nan
authors: Park J.; Im S.; Lee K.-H.; Lee J.-O.
key_contribution: Presents a vision-based SLAM architecture for small UAVs splitting onboard KLT real-time tracking with ground-station SIFT mapping and 3D line/plane reconstruction in GPS-denied environments.
